title: Your Paycheck Just Went Global
summary: Direct deposit is here for the Remitly Global Card. Customers can get paid, spend, save, or send money abroad, all from one place.
body_markdown:
*Customers can now get paid directly onto the Remitly Global Card, and use their paycheck to spend, save, or send money around the world.*


For millions of people living global lives, payday is just the start. You might use your paycheck for everyday expenses, put some aside for savings, or send money to loved ones abroad. Now with direct deposit to your Remitly Global Card, you can manage your money without moving it between accounts first.


And there’s more: customers can earn a bonus after receiving eligible direct deposits, and get our best FX rate on wallet-funded sends. No promo code or extra eligibility check required.


Getting started is simple. Customers can create a direct deposit switch form in the Remitly app to give to their employer, or directly switch in the Remitly app by linking their employer with just a few clicks.


This is another feature with the Remitly Global Card, a place where customers can move money through every step of their financial life.


*The Remitly Global Card is available today to eligible, invited customers, with the Card’s regional rollout expanding globally through the remainder of 2026. Haven’t been invited yet? Join the waitlist at*[remitly.com/cards](http://remitly.com/cards) *.*
